notes.title: Demo patch #3
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft under your steps!

Here's a quick bugfix patch! Work on the improved discovery system is still ongoing and making progress. If you want to know more about this, you can get more details in my latest blogpost.

Demo Version 0.2.1

Fixes:

- Fixed: Occasional crashes when two greenfeet are looking for the same equipment piece.
- Fixed: Occasional crashes during world generation on slower computers.

notes.title: Demo patch #2
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft under your steps!

Here's the second demo patch, focused on fixing bugs. It also contains some gameplay tweaks.

I'm now working on the next demo update with two main goals:

- Improving the discovery system to enhance the overall experience
- Adding more content, including items, furnishings, structures, and more

Thank you for your patience!

Demo Version 0.2.0

Added:

- Added: New room system. Any enclosed area will now be considered as a room, and the rest as outside.
- Added: Keyboard bindings for changing game speed.
- Added: Alerts when greenfeet have no jobs.
- Added: Helper text about jobs in the preview panel of a jobless greenfeet.
- Added: Linux support, but official Steam builds are not yet available.


Changes:

- Changed: Sub-tasks icons will no longer be displayed to avoid them stacking with their parent task.
- Changed: Prevented camera to move outside of the map.
- Changed: Savegames are now located inside the cache folder instead of document folder.
- Changed: Items no longer spread to adjacent tiles, they spread visually within the tile they were spawned on.
- Changed: New AI algorithm for job, tool and activity lookup.
- Changed: Improved rendering performances with a 90% reduction of displayed sprites.
- Changed: New save format enabling migration support.
- Changed: Greenfeet will now stop working exactly when the workshift is over instead of finishing their current task.
- Changed: Added a preemption system for tasks: greenfeet will now lock a building job if they take care of bringing the items.
- Changed: All furnishings are now crossable.

Fixes:

- Fixed: Culled items not being haulable.
- Fixed: Items changing of variant sprite when being culled.
- Fixed: Invisible hauled items when grabbed offscreen.
- Fixed: Interrupted haul jobs not relocated to the item's new position.
- Fixed: Blinking plant textures when changing season.
- Fixed: Deleted zone not clearing inhabitants.
- Fixed: Plant bounce not working when loading a save.
- Fixed: Stumps not being removed if preventing a task to be completed.
- Fixed: Items not being moved out from cut plants when building above them.
- Fixed: Cut button not being toggled on trees in some cases.
- Fixed: Greenfeet stuck if trying to perform a job they are already standing upon.
- Fixed: Doors and some walls being considered as part of a room.
- Fixed: Not eating at a table if the meal is above a chair.
- Fixed: Furniture "facing" property not updated after loading a save.
- Fixed: Crash during game unloading to main menu.
- Fixed: Crash when revealing a sector with lone greenfeet and having removed the default laborer job.
- Fixed: Visual glitches in the UI when using Windows' display scaling setting.
- Fixed: Orphan jobs cases when items/furnitures are removed.
- Fixed: Added check at startup to verify the save folder is not writable.
- Fixed: Workers staying assigned to deleted zones.
- Fixed: Orphaned haul jobs staying active.
- Fixed: Batch of english typos.
- Fixed: Hauling jobs being issued for items that are attached to a crafting or building job.
- Fixed: Dropped items blinking randomly.
- Fixed: Missing ground, wall and roof textures on some older driver or integrated GPUs.
- Fixed: Green checkmark not going away in the discovery bench when obtaining new materials.
- Fixed: Unconsistent activity score sorting leading to starving greenfeet.
- Fixed: Opening the menu using the UI not pausing the game.
- Fixed: Map dragging interrupted when crossing UI parts.
- Fixed: Special chars crashing when used in a save file name.
- Fixed: Invalid move out and hauling jobs causing stuck greenfeet.
- Fixed: Performance issue when spawning dead leaves during the storm season.
- Fixed: Performance issue when cleaning dead leaves during the cold season.
- Fixed: Pathfinding failures when crossing enclosed spaces with a mix of zones.
- Fixed: Greenfeet working for an hour too long.
- Fixed: Wrong storage zone displayed when editing a zone-based craft order.
- Fixed: Move out tasks not performed if using custom zone jobs.
- Fixed: Greenfeet having incompatible traits like Lazy + Hard worker.
- Fixed: Exhausted greenfeet waking up right away.
- Fixed: Invisible greenfeet when returning from exploration.
- Fixed: Being able to build on water.
- Fixed: Collapsing roofs overriding water with dirt.
- Fixed: "Forever" settings on crafting zones not working.
- Fixed: Missing tool notification blinking when tools are picked up by greenfeet.

notes.title: Demo patch #1
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft under your steps!

Here's the first demo patch to address urgent bugs and feedback that you sent me. Thank you for taking time to play the demo!

Demo Version 0.1.cdd54341

Fixes

- Fixed: Game starting in windowed mode instead of fullscreen.
- Fixed: Furnishings preventing building roofs.
- Fixed: Stone bricks not unlocking a valid recipe.
- Fixed: Doors not disappearing when removed.
- Fixed: Wheat bundles not spawning.
- Fixed: Snow sprite blinking when accumulating on the ground or melting.
- Fixed: Fixed typos in the tutorial.
- Fixed: Fixed text rendering when using scale greather than 100% in Windows display settings.
- Fixed: Prevented tutorial bubbles overflowing from screen at lower resolutions.
- Fixed: Made the cursor bigger.
- Fixed: UI content overflowing on lower resolutions, scroll bars not visible enough.
